data.body: Plan-review PASSED (certified, file_impact basis, verified_at_sha 49c2067). One non-blocking advisory remains (T2, deferred priority 0.78): MCP_MEM_MIN_MB=1024 default lacks a stated basis in the container's real RSS. Disposition: the default is a conservative floor (headroom for one extra rebar-mcp container — Python + LLM client — on the 8 GiB t4g.large) and is operator-tunable via MCP_MEM_MIN_MB; the pre-check fails OPEN if MemAvailable is unreadable, so a wrong threshold cannot wedge deploys. Left as a tunable to be validated against measured RSS in a follow-up rather than hard-coding an unmeasured number.
